system.description:
The questing knight: no order, no lord, no stronghold, just the code and the road.

  • Universal Bearing (1st): your Inspire works on creatures who can't understand your language, and reaches 60ft.
  • Roads Well Travelled (1st): Advantage on lore checks about distant lands, knighthood's history and famous deeds of arms.
  • Far Challenge (5th): your Challenge reaches 60ft.
  • Friends on Every Road (10th): in any town, keep or crossroads you reach, you know someone.
  • Name them and say how you met; the GM says what they can offer (a bed, a rumour, an introduction, a small favour).
  • Each friend helps once until you do them a good turn back.
